name: block-info-cap
summary: Zone.exe loads at most 256 map block infos per process (MapBlockInformationBox::mbib_array[256]). Relocate the box and raise the bound.
status: WORKING 2026-09-14: chained in build/Zone.maps.exe, a zone booted READY with BlockDistribute 105/124, block infos 307/1024, MapCluster nodes 22/36 (all above stock) and a bot joined; see NOTES-map-caps.md.

target.note: Chained builds need --allow-hash-mismatch; no other recipe touches these sites.

infos.why: Every operand is imm32/disp32; the ceiling is only memory (0xB50 = 2896 bytes per entry, 1024 entries = 2.97 MB). 65536 would be 190 MB of image - far beyond any use.

why: MapBlockInformationBox (?blockinfobox@@3V..., a static at 0xD68AB10, 741,380 bytes) is
mbib_array[256] of 0xB50 bytes {Name3 mapid; xsize; ysize; MapBlockInformation} followed by
int mbib_Number at +0xB5000. mbib_Load (0x49E940) finds a map's entry by name or appends one at
mbib_Number; `cmp eax, 0x100` guards the append and ac_Asserts 'Too many block info[256]'. A zone with
many field maps (every FieldMap instance loads one, instance copies included) hits it.
CRT ctor stub 0x696800: push 0x100; push 0xB50; push 0xD68AB10; call eh vector ctor;
atexit stub 0x69D890:   push 0x100; push 0xB50; push 0xD68AB10; call eh vector dtor
No data-section pointer. The box has no constructor symbol: the CRT stub IS the constructor, so the
element count lives in the two stubs and nowhere else.
Relocating moves the whole object (array + count) to a section of infos*0xB50 + 4 bytes: four object
addresses, two vector counts, the bound, and six count-member offsets (register-relative disp32 in
mbib_Load, absolute in the stub) become infos*0xB50. Materialised so the vector ctor and the count
store find real memory under this loader.

edits.why: CRT ctor stub: vector ctor element count
CRT ctor stub: vector ctor object address
atexit stub: vector dtor element count
atexit stub: vector dtor object address
